name: evals
description: Build, run and hillclimb evals for anything that shapes what an agent does: a plugin, skill, MCP server, instruction file, system prompt or model. One command says what a suite needs next, and results are kept, named and reused, so a change is measured against a baseline without running the baseline again. Its own runner works under Claude Code or Codex, with Opus judges, cases cut from real sessions and paired comparisons.
